sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier: body length 5.4—5.5 mm; antennal segment 3 thicker than the remaining segments and longer than segments 2, 4 and 5 together; eye spot pigmented; anterior margin of the pronotum deeply concave, the anterior corners raised, rounded and directed toward the head; postmentum length / minimum postmentum width = 4.75. Alate: body length 6.3 mm; antenna 16-segmented; distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head 4 times the eye width; wings yellow chestnut, densely punctate; M forked at the wing apex with a small branch running toward Rs; Rs with 6 side branches reaching the costal margin.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Female (alate, morfotipo). Coloration: overall dark chestnut; head, antennae, wings, abdomen and femora yellow chestnut; pronotum dark chestnut; ocelli and tibiae transparent. Head 1.3 times as long as wide; posterior margin of the eye slightly convex. Labrum rounded. Antenna 16-segmented, segment 3 nearly clavate, slightly longer than segments 4 and 5. Compound eyes large, their distance to the lower margin of the head 4 times their width. Ocelli round, reaching the margin of the compound eye. Mandibular dentition as in Fig. 3. Pronotum subquadrate, 1.5 times as wide as long; anterior and posterior margins both shallowly concave; anterior and lateral margins with short setae. Fore wing scale reaching the base of the hind wing scale, its anterior margin slightly convex. Wings densely punctate; Su short; R without side branches; Rs reaching the wing apex, with 6 side branches running toward the costal margin; M slightly pigmented, forked at the wing apex with a small branch running toward Rs; R, Rs and Cu deeply pigmented. Tibiae hairy; tibial spurs 3:3:3. Tarsi 4-segmented; arolia not projecting. Abdominal segments with distinct setae.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Holotype (soldier). Coloration: head, antennal segment 3, anterior margin of the pronotum and labrum dark yellow chestnut or brown; mandibles red chestnut; pronotum, abdomen and legs pale yellow chestnut; clypeus transparent. Head longer than wide, the sides nearly parallel. Clypeus simple, slightly lobed. Labrum rounded, with short setae, and 2 distinct long setae at the apex. Eye spot slightly pigmented, its distance to the antennal base equal to its width. Antenna 10-segmented, reaching the apex of the mandibles; segment 3 thicker than the remaining ones, nearly clavate, slightly longer than segments 2, 4 and 5 together; each segment with short setae at the apex. Mandibles 1.1 times the maximum head width, the apical tooth (A) projecting; marginal teeth M1 and M2 nearly equal in size; posterior margin of M1 larger than the anterior margin of M2; M3 small; a further distinct tooth at the base. Right mandible with A distinct; M2 larger than M1; a small tooth at the base. Postmentum narrow in the middle, with a concavity on the right anterolateral margin. Pronotum twice as wide as long, slightly wider than the head; anterior margin deeply and roundly concave; posterior margin slightly concave; lateral margins with short setae. Abdominal tergites with short setae. Hind femur thickened. Tibial spines 3:3:3, shorter than the tibial width. Tarsal segment 3 longer than the remaining ones.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Soldier measurements (Table 1, mm; holotype / paratype mean / paratype range): head length (excluding mandibles) 1.10 / 1.31 / 1.25—1.37; head length (including mandibles) 2.20 / 2.31 / 2.25—2.37; head side length 1.25 / 1.35 / 1.30—1.40; head depth 0.70 / 0.65 / 0.60—0.70; maximum head width 0.95 / 0.97 / 0.95—1.00; eye spot width 0.08 / 0.10 / 0.10; left mandible length 0.95 / 0.95 / 0.95; postmentum length 0.95 / 0.82 / 0.80—0.85; maximum postmentum width 0.35 / 0.35 / 0.35; minimum postmentum width 0.20 / 0.20 / 0.20; pronotum length 0.45 / 0.45 / 0.45, width 0.95 / 0.92 / 0.90—0.95; hind tibia length 0.85 / 0.70 / 0.55—0.85; body length 5.50 / 5.40 / 5.40—5.50. Alate measurements (Table 2, mm; female of this species / I. bequaerti after Snyder 1929): head length 1.05 / 1.20—1.25; head width including compound eyes 0.80 / 0.90—0.95; compound eye diameter 0.10 / 0.26—0.27; ocellus length 0.12, width 0.07; postocular distance 0.40; interocular distance 0.57; subocular distance 0.15; head depth 0.60; pronotum length 0.55 / 0.65—0.70, width 0.85 / 1.0—1.05; hind tibia length 0.70 / 0.70—0.80; fore wing length 5.00 / 7.80—8.0, width 1.20 / 2.15—2.20; fore wing scale length 0.60; body length without wings 4.50 / 5.25—6.75, with wings 6.30 / 9.75—10.50. Variation: the right margin of the postmentum lacks a concavity in one soldier. Type locality: Cayo Sevilla, southern Las Tunas Province, Cuba; holotype (soldier) collected in June 1988 (month 6) at the roots of red mangrove (Rhizophora mangle) by J. de la Cruz and R. Alayo; alate (morfotipo) with the same data; paratypes 2 soldiers and 12 pseudergates with the same data.

note: Adapted from the original description (in Spanish) published with the species by Hernández (1994); there is a detailed description of the soldier holotype and a description of the alate (morfotipo), with two measurement tables and a comparison with I. bequaerti. The specific name refers to the host tree, red mangrove (Rhyzophora mangle, spelled thus in the original). Two rows of the soldier table of the OCR are clearly displaced (minimum head width, left mandible length); they have been entered from the legible majority values, and only the consistent values are retained at the corresponding places.
